The '''Chenataa river''' was a [[river]] which ran through the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Great Tree]] of Kkowir Forest resided on an island within the river.
